Method of Attack: DLL Hijacking by placing a malicious wtsapi32.dll in the browser executable folder to hijack browser homepage
Attack Vector: Malicious DLL placed in the same directory as browser executables causing the browser to load the malicious DLL instead of the legitimate one
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious wtsapi32.dll file in browser folder
Registry key HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\MessageGet 'hp' value containing hijacked homepage URL
